label.zh: 到期时消费品库存是否超过配额
label.en: Whether the consumer-goods stockpile exceeds the quota at expiry

note.zh: 超过 paperclips_once_again → 5005 选择奖励；否则 → 5006 失败惩罚。两者30天后重新启动 5000。
note.en: Above paperclips_once_again -> 5005 choose a reward; otherwise -> 5006 failure penalty. Both restart 5000 after 30 days.

scope.zh: 强迫指令局势“商品整合”：周期性生产配额，成功得奖励、失败受惩罚后重启。
scope.en: The Obsessional Directive situation "Commodities Consolidation": a recurring production quota with a reward on success and a penalty on failure, then a restart.
